text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I can definitely feel the progress...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Way to go, Lucky Lilac!
We can seriously expect great things from her...!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder which path they'll take...
Man, they're definitely one to watch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lucky Lilac returned after completing her debut race safely. Despite just finishing the race, she seemed thoroughly invigorated in both mind and body...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
How did it look to you, Trainer?
My running today, that is.
choice_data_list: It was great content that really builds toward the future!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
I felt a good response myself, too.
choice_data_list: Let's keep this momentum going and decide on our future goals.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh—
Do you have an idea?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's run confirmed it.
With her talent, she should be able to aim for stardom and challenge the top stage starting right from the Junior Class...!
choice_data_list: Why don't we make the "Hanshin JF" our main goal?
Why don't you make the "Hanshin JF" your main goal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is a 1600m turf GⅠ race held at Hanshin Racecourse in December.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only Junior-year runners are eligible for this race,
and many Umamusume aiming for the Tiara route choose it as their gateway to success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If Lucky Lilac can win this race, she will likely reign early on as the queen of the Junior Class."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That achievement should bring her significantly closer to the "spotlight" she strives for...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I've thought this for a while now,
but you're quite bold, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I wouldn't have asked,
"Form a comedy duo with me!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I wouldn't have asked,
"Form a comedy duo with me!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, I think it's grand.
That kind of boldness.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
――Please let me ride.
I want to run in the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Let us seize it with our own hands.
The title of Junior Class Queen...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And in one fell swoop, I'll carve open
the path to the "spotlight."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac and I set our sights
on winning the Hanshin JF to become the Junior-class Queen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ââHah!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Phew...—
choice_data_list: Good, you're starting to fix the issues from your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I'm startin' to get a good feel for it, so I wanna keep this momentum goin'.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: My word... That was such a polished run, hard to believe she just debuted. I'm really looking forward to her future.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. I am still learning,
so I would be grateful if you would continue to watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, reporters had come to interview
Lucky Lilac about her training and future plans."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems attention on her is growing even faster than I imagined.
Part of me can't help but feel proud of that—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "Have you decided on your future plans... such as which route you'll aim for? If you wouldn't mind sharing what you can..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
Is it alright if I say something?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Right now, I'm aiming for the Hanshin JF.
Winning there and becoming the Junior Class Queen
is my current goal!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! Setting your sights so high right from the start—impressive as always! And the Tiara route suits you wonderfully!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Told ya so~~~~!!!
I was waitin' for ya to ask that very question, Mr. Reporter!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If you're the "star attraction," your interview answers gotta have flair too.
I'll deliver a killer line right here and leave a lasting impression...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Just qualifying to run in a GⅠ is difficult in itself.
I am well aware of that. However—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely enter the race and answer all the expectations
everyone gave me today with victory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lucky Lilac is exceptional.
Even so, winning a GⅠ will require her
to raise her level significantly higher than it is now."
choice_data_list: (I've gotta give it everything I've got, too.)
(I've got to give it my all, too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer, I must keep thinking.
What can I do so she can grow faster
and grander toward the spotlight—"
